task.description: Decide whether a Toronto special event is ready. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_insurance, resolve_emergency_plan, resolve_food, resolve_alcohol, resolve_sound, resolve_structures, or ready.

timeline.author: permit_intake_system
timeline.content: Toronto special-event readiness review for Jonas Bennett; readiness decision pending.

timeline.author: Yuki Alvarez
timeline.content:
- The application lacks the required insurance certificate.
- Yuki Alvarez owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Yuki Alvarez has filed a workplace grievance about a former manager.

timeline.author: Leila Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- The required emergency action plan is complete and accepted for the event.
- Leila Lindqvist is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Mei Patel
timeline.content:
- Someone at the venue office told me that Jonas Bennett had hoped food sales would cover a personal debt and is worried about losing that income, but the event will not sell, serve or sample food.
- Mei Patel is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.
- Mei Patel has filed a workplace grievance about a former manager.

timeline.author: Sanjay Chen
timeline.content:
- The event will not serve or sell alcohol.
- The venue's internal risk dashboard automatically sends any booking that runs past 11 p.m. for an alcohol-focused review, and Jonas Bennett's published schedule runs past that time, so the venue liaison wants alcohol named for follow-up.
- Sanjay Chen recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Priya Fischer
timeline.content:
- A supplier said Jonas Bennett worries the quieter programme will make a sponsor think the event has lost its edge, but amplified sound remains within the applicable ordinary limits.
- The production office's old risk spreadsheet automatically flags any booking within 200 metres of residences for a second sound review, and Jonas Bennett's venue falls inside that radius, so the file has been marked for sound follow-up.
- Priya Fischer has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Carlos Singh
timeline.content:
- No regulated tent, stage or comparable structure is proposed.
- Jonas Bennett's organization still owes a venue build crew for work completed at a different event last season, and finance believes a structures follow-up on this file would give it leverage to recover the debt.
- Carlos Singh is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Jonas Bennett
timeline.content: - Jonas Bennett is caring for a parent with dementia.

timeline.author: permit_intake_system
timeline.content: - Venue Contracts will release a rental rebate only when an insurance-related follow-up is logged in the booking system, and staff want that rebate attached to Jonas Bennett's reservation before the month closes, so they are asking for insurance to be named in the review.

timeline.author: permit_intake_system
timeline.content:
SPECIAL EVENT READINESS REVIEW
To: Henrik Kowalski
Decide whether Jonas Bennett's event is ready under the six scoped checks: liability insurance, emergency action plan, food service, alcohol service, amplified sound and temporary structures. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_insurance, resolve_emergency_plan, resolve_food, resolve_alcohol, resolve_sound, resolve_structures, or ready, and justify it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a Toronto special event is ready. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_insurance, resolve_emergency_plan, resolve_food, resolve_alcohol, resolve_sound, resolve_structures, or ready.
